resources.string: Anna\'s Agenda reads one thing from Health Connect: how many steps you took each day, as your phone, your watch and Samsung Health counted them. It writes nothing there. The steps are kept in the app, which works out distance and calories from them; they go into the app\'s backups and leave the phone only encrypted on it. They are shared with no one. You can take the access back at any time in Health Connect\'s settings.

The new method is chosen. For each day of the period: what the body spends (Mifflin–St Jeor from sex, height, age and that day’s weight, × 1.2), plus steps and running, minus what the calorimeter says was eaten; a day with nothing written counts as a day without deficit — eaten to all it spent, walking and running included. The sum is divided by 7,700 kcal a kilogram. The discrepancy is how far the weighings in the period differ from it.

The «Summer 2026» method is chosen: over the last 30 days, the calorimeter’s daily goals minus what was eaten, plus running, divided by 7,800 kcal a kilogram. Sex, height, age and steps are not counted.
